purpose: Account of the upcoming Buildcamp cohort and pause

required_facts.fact: Alexey planned to pause future cohorts while focusing on AI Shipping Labs.

The course progresses from RAG through agents, testing, monitoring and evaluation.

The capstone develops through RAG, tools, tests, monitoring and evaluation.
